svg.title: ZeroInject secure-chat detection and enforcement flow
svg.desc: A chat message is sanitized by an LLM, blocked early if no legitimate intent remains, otherwise scored by three Groq-hosted verifier models with weighted consensus, mapped to BLOCK, SANITIZE or ALLOW by a threshold policy and router overrides, then either answered with a canned reply or forwarded to the chatbot model, with every completed request logged to SQLite for the analytics dashboard.
svg.text: Three verifiers evaluate the original input.
A single-agent recheck of the sanitized text
pᵢ = conf if injection, else 1 − conf
SQLite · verdict · injection_score · action_taken · agent1–3 verdicts · attack_type · chatbot_response
